name: Playa del Carmen
summary: Playa del Carmen, in the Riviera Maya, is one of Latin America's favorite nomadic destinations: Caribbean beach, pedestrian Fifth Avenue full of cafes and coworkings, and fast fiber optics in most buildings. The international community is huge and the Cancun airport is only an hour away. The cost of living has risen with mass tourism, and it is worth taking into account the hurricane season (June-November) and the recent increase in perceived insecurity in some areas.
